title: Short-Rate Retention on Coverage Returns, Including Vehicle Substitutions
content:
**Rule.** Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), the share kept from the coverage return is set as follows:
- **Total loss declared.** When the latest claim records a total loss declaration, nothing is kept.
- **Vehicle substitution.** When it does not, and the latest vehicle added to the owner term (latest by change effective date) took effect no earlier than the owner package's replacement-vehicle reporting days before today and no later than today, both of those days counted, the substitution short-rate percent of 5.0 percent is kept.
- **Otherwise.** The owner package's short-rate retention percent is kept.

The vehicle-added changes are those recorded on the Owner Auto Policy term the coverage belongs to. The reporting days and the short-rate retention percent are those of that term's Owner Auto Policy package. Every Owner Auto Policy package sets 30 replacement-vehicle reporting days. The short-rate retention percent is:
- 10.0 percent on the Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability, Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability, Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability and Cardinal Point 100/300/50 Liability packages;
- 0.0 percent on the Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability and Cardinal Point 250/500/100 Liability packages.

### Window boundaries (hypothetical, removal asked for today, 30 reporting days, no total loss declaration)

| Effective date of the latest vehicle added to the owner term | Share kept |
|---|---|
| Today | 5.0 percent |
| 30 days before today | 5.0 percent |
| 31 days before today | The owner package's percent |
| A date after today | The owner package's percent |
| No vehicle added | The owner package's percent |
